questions.q: Who kept everybody away from the Doctor's door while he slept?
choices: Polynesia
Chee-Chee
The Grand Gorilla
Jip
questions.evidence: CHEE-CHEE stood outside the Doctor's door, keeping everybody away

questions.q: What did the Grand Gorilla think would make the Doctor stay?
choices: Making him King of all the monkeys in the jungle forever
A new house, a bigger bed and plenty of monkey-servants
Giving him fifty bags of cocoanuts and a boat of his own
Asking the Leader of the Lions to tell him he must stay
questions.evidence: if we make him a new house and a bigger bed

questions.q: Why did Chee-Chee say it was useless to ask the Doctor to stay?
choices: The Doctor owed money in Puddleby and said he must go back and pay it
The Doctor missed his sister Sarah and wanted to see her again
The Doctor was afraid the King of the Jolliginki's soldiers would catch him
The Doctor did not like the hot weather in the Land of the Monkeys
questions.evidence: He owes money in Puddleby; and he says he must go back and pay it.

questions.q: Why did the Doctor feel he must get the sailor another boat?
choices: The sailor had made him promise to bring two boats back
The sailor said he would tell the King if he did not
The sailor was poor and his ship was all he had
The sailor needed a much bigger boat for his fishing
questions.evidence: because the man was poor and his ship was all he had

questions.q: Why did Chee-Chee say bananas and cocoanuts were not a good present?
choices: The Doctor did not like to eat fruit of any kind
They would be too heavy to carry so far and would go bad
The Doctor could buy plenty of them back home in Puddleby for a penny
The swallows would eat them all on the long way home
questions.evidence: would go bad before half was eaten

questions.q: What are "menageries," as Chee-Chee explains them?
choices: Big ships that carry wild animals across the sea to other far-off lands
Farms where people keep cows, sheep and horses in fields
Places where animals are kept in cages for people to look at
Schools where children learn to talk to animals
questions.evidence: places in the Land of the White Men, where animals were put in cages

questions.q: Which rare animal did Chee-Chee finally say they should give the Doctor?
choices: An iguana
An okapi
A pushmi-pullyu
A red marmoset

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: How the monkeys learned what money is from Chee-Chee
How the monkeys decided on a thank-you present for the Doctor before he left
How Chee-Chee told the monkeys about the London Zoo
How the monkeys built the Doctor a new house and a bigger bed so he would stay
questions.evidence: Let us give him the finest present a man ever had!
